ariaLabel.description:
Accessible label exposed via `aria-label` on the root element. Defaults
to the localized "Loading" message. Override it to describe the specific
activity (e.g. "Uploading file").

className.description:
Custom class name merged onto the root element alongside the component's
own classes.

size.description: Visual size. `base` renders at 32px, `small` renders at 16px.

style.description: Custom inline styles applied to the root element.
